konu: Theme 2: Friendship — Describing Personal Qualities of a Good Friend, Friendship Idioms & Relative Clauses
ciktilar: İyi bir arkadaşta bulunması gereken olumlu ve olumsuz kişilik özelliklerini (personal qualities) doğru sıfatlarla betimler.
Kişilik (What is s/he like?) ve fiziksel görünüş (What does s/he look like?) soru kalıplarını ayırt ederek kullanır.
Arkadaşlık ilişkilerini anlatan deyimleri (idioms) ve deyimsel fiilleri (phrasal verbs) bağlam içinde yorumlar.
İnsanları ve arkadaşlık niteliklerini tanımlarken ilgi cümleciklerini (Relative Clauses: who, whom, whose, that) kurallarına uygun biçimde kullanır.
hatirla: Personal qualities: supportive (destekleyici), trustworthy (güvenilir), stubborn (inatçı), generous (cömert), tactful (ince düşünceli).
'What is s/he like?' asks about character/personality, whereas 'What does s/he look like?' asks about physical appearance.
Common idioms: 'see eye to eye' (agree), 'count on / rely on' (trust), 'back up' (support), 'get on well with' (have a good relationship).

sorular.soru: Match the friendship adjectives with their correct English definitions.
ciftler: A person who can be trusted completely and never shares your secrets
A person who always encourages and helps you when you face difficulties
A person who refuses to change their mind even when proven wrong
A person who is willing to give money, time or help freely to others

sorular.soru: Choose the correct relative pronoun to complete the sentence: 'A genuine friend is someone ___ always stands by you through thick and thin.'
Which phrasal verb means 'to support, encourage or defend someone when they need help'?
Mark the statements about friendship and English structures as True (D) or False (Y).

ifadeler.metin: 'What does she look like?' is used to ask about a person's inner personality and habits.
'To count on someone' means to rely on and trust that person unconditionally.
'Whose' is used in relative clauses to indicate possession regarding people.
'To fall out with a friend' means to start a very warm and intimate friendship.

sorular.soru: Complete the personality adjectives with their antonyms (opposites) in the table.
Order the steps of developing a strong and meaningful friendship logically.
ogeler: Meeting a new person and starting a conversation
Discovering common interests, music and hobbies
Having deep conversations and sharing feelings
Backing each other up through tough personal times
Establishing permanent mutual trust and loyalty

sorular.soru: What does the English idiom 'to see eye to eye with someone' mean in a conversation?
secenekler: To agree completely on a topic or decision
To look at someone angrily during an argument
To have the exact same eye color as your friend
To criticize someone without noticing their feelings

sorular.soru: Which question structure should you ask when you want to learn about someone's character rather than appearance?
Match the friendship idioms with their correct meanings.
ciftler: To quickly become very good friends with someone upon meeting
To depend on and trust someone to do what they promised
To admire and respect someone as an inspiring role model
To enjoy spending time and having a friendly relationship

sorular.soru: Evaluate the grammar rules and friendship expressions as True (D) or False (Y).

ifadeler.metin: 'Which' can be used instead of 'who' when describing human personality traits.
A tactful friend always thinks carefully before speaking to avoid hurting others.
'To have a lot in common' means sharing similar tastes, hobbies and viewpoints.
'Self-centred' describes an empathetic person who always puts friends first.

sorular.soru: Use the personality clues to solve the puzzle. Find the core friendship value hidden in the orange key boxes.

satirlar.ipucu: Telling the truth and never lying to friends
Can be trusted to do what is right and expected
Showing empathy and listening to other people
Giving emotional help and encouraging people
Careful not to say things that upset people

sorular.soru: Explain briefly why reliability is considered the most essential quality in a friendship.
sorular.cevap: It creates honest mutual bonds and ensures you can.
